dialogue_turns.text: Is your kid always dysregulated, melting down over little things? Then the shoes feel wrong. Their whole body goes rigid. Big feelings get trapped inside. Constant tears, slamming doors. And that tense feeling just won't go away. Soon, asking for something simple starts feeling like a risk. You brace yourself mornings, dinners, bedtimes. And instead of enjoying your kid, you're waiting for the next meltdown to start. Day after day, your home feels loud, tense, and exhausting, leaving you drained before your day is even over. What if your kid has been asking for a different kind of support? Just one printable feelings chart with your kid every day can help them name feelings, and leave your home feeling lighter and more peaceful. No more bracing yourself before every request. No more worrying about meltdowns or tantrums, just a kid who names feelings, calmer evenings and time to enjoy them. Add one feelings chart a day from the free Kids Mental Health Bundle and give your kid support. Grab yours free.
